column1: # One row per cipher unit (2,368). sign = first-transcription code; key = letter by key.tsv with P printed t; shape_nonblind = the shape verdict of the second look (not blind; d t l, ? undecided, d?/t? leaning, empty = not a tall sign, not_sheeted = not looked at); letter_consensus = key with firm shape verdicts applied; blind_class = the blind shape test (A hook closed on stem = d, B open hat over tick = t, C bowl at foot = l, D unclear; blind for sign P only, C on sign D set from the code); letter_blind = key with blind classes applied; reading = the letter the reading takes (_ unread, - dropped, (tt) one sign for two letters). class: S same, E reading differs, N not read.
